urls.title: Page URLs
urls.description: Pages to audit, one per line. Full URLs (https://example.com/pricing) or domains (example.com, audits the homepage). Up to 10,000 per run.

sitemapUrls.title: Websites or sitemaps to audit in full
sitemapUrls.description: Audit every page listed in a website's sitemap. Give a sitemap URL (https://example.com/sitemap.xml, indexes and .gz files work) or just the website (example.com): the sitemaps are found from robots.txt or /sitemap.xml.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: Stop after this many pages in total (page URLs first, then sitemap pages).

sitemapUrlFilter.title: Only sitemap URLs matching
sitemapUrlFilter.description: Optional regular expression; only sitemap pages whose URL matches are audited. Example: /blog/ or /products/.

checkRobotsTxt.title: Check robots.txt
checkRobotsTxt.description: Read each website's robots.txt once and report whether Googlebot may crawl each page (robotsTxtAllowed).

includeHeadings.title: Include H2 headings
includeHeadings.description: Adds the text of up to 30 H2 headings per page. H1 headings are always included.

includeLinks.title: Include link lists
includeLinks.description: Adds every internal and external link (URL and anchor text) on each page. Counts are always included.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel pages
maxConcurrency.description: How many pages to fetch at the same time. At most 3 at once per website, to stay polite.
